lede: LSU carries the stronger underlying team rating — +8.9 against +6.4, a 2.6-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it LSU -5.1 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with LSU winning 63% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is continuity, where Texas A&M leads LSU by 121 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 80% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
